import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { ScrollArea } from "@workspace/ui/components/scroll-area" const contacts = [ "Aiko", "Ali Imam", "Ben", "Bianca", "Carlos", "Chloe", "Dev", "Dina", "Elif", "Emil", "Farah", "Felix", "Gia", "Hana", "Hugo", ] export default function StickyAlphabetContacts() { const groups = contacts.reduce>((acc, name) => { const key = name[0]! ;(acc[key] ??= []).push(name) return acc }, {}) return ( {Object.entries(groups).map(([letter, names]) => (
{letter}
{names.map((name) => (
{name .split(" ") .map((p) => p[0]) .join("")} {name}
))}
))} ) }
